extracted.intended_audience: Congress, PTO leadership, federal stakeholders, and financial managers
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and reporting of a federal agency's (USPTO) financial management, internal controls, resource management, and performance using OMB measures, financial ratios, and accounting systems. Focused on FY1999 PTO practices, constraints, and performance indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management controls — FMFIA compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: We provided reasonable assurance of compliance with the provisions of the Federal Managers' Financial Integrity Act. Management controls are adequate to ensure transactions are executed in accordance with budgetary and financial laws and other requirements, are consistent with the purposes authorized, and are recorded in accordance with Federal accounting standards; assets are properly acquired and used and are safeguarded to deter theft, accidental loss, unauthorized disposition, or fraud; and performance measurement information is adequately supported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assurance is based on continued efforts to improve internal accounting and administrative controls. Example: corrective action was implemented to substantially eliminate control weakness in the Revenue Accounting and Management (RAM) system identified by DOC OIG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of Timely Vendor Payments
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance measure tracking the percentage of vendor payments made on time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB-prescribed quantitative indicator. PTO FY1999 target shown as 99% (table). Used to monitor improvements in financial management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of Payroll by Electronic Transfer
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance measure tracking the percentage of payroll paid by electronic transfer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB-prescribed quantitative indicator. PTO FY1999 target shown as 95% (table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of Treasury Agency Locations Fully Reconciled
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance measure tracking reconciliation completeness of Treasury agency locations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB-prescribed quantitative indicator. PTO FY1999 target shown as 97% (table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely Posting of Inter-Agency Charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance measure tracking timeliness of posting inter-agency charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB-prescribed quantitative indicator. PTO FY1999 target shown as 90% (table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely Reports to Central Agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance measure tracking the timeliness of mandated reports to central agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB-prescribed quantitative indicator. PTO FY1999 target shown as 100% (table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Average Processing Time for Travel Payments
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance measure tracking average days to process travel payments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB-prescribed quantitative indicator. PTO FY1999 target shown as 18 days (table) and other travel measure target 2 days / 15 days in table; used to benchmark internal processing efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit opinion on fiscal year financial statements
rubrics_metrics.description: The independent auditor's opinion on the agency's financial statements (e.g., 'Unqualified').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a high-level indicator of fair presentation and conformance with Federal accounting/reporting standards; PTO received an unqualified opinion for FY1999.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material weaknesses reported
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether material weaknesses or reportable conditions in internal control were identified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB/IG reporting outcome; for FY1999 none were identified due to corrective actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return on Net Position (financial ratio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures management performance and operating effectiveness in terms of results of operations per dollar of net position.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher returns typically reflect higher performance; interpretation differs from private sector because of restricted surcharge amounts. PTO presents values both including and net of surcharge to show effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Assets Turnover (financial ratio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures operating efficiency in terms of total revenue per dollar of total assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher turnover indicates greater ability to use assets to generate revenue; PTO notes decline largely due to inclusion of OBRA surcharge amounts and presents net-of-surcharge comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cash Flow Return on Assets (financial ratio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures operating effectiveness in terms of cash generated from operations per dollar of total assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher cash flow returns reflect greater operating performance; comparison with and without surcharge amounts is significant for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations Index (financial ratio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures operating effectiveness in terms of cash generated from operations per dollar of results of operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher index reflects greater operating performance; PTO presents index both including and net of surcharge to reveal surcharge effects (range reported, including negative values net of surcharge).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current Ratio (financial ratio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures the adequacy of resources in terms of current assets per dollar of current liabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ratios > 1.0 indicate current assets are sufficient to cover current liabilities; PTO warns inclusion of restricted surcharge cash can mask true liquidity and reports net-of-surcharge ratios near 1.0.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budgetary constraint: customer-funded operating model (OBRA implications)
rubrics_metrics.description: PTO is a fully customer-funded federal agency operating like a commercial enterprise but remains subject to federal appropriations laws: no investment authority, no borrowing authority, no lines of credit; to obligate a dollar, it must have already been collected; fees must cover outstanding obligations by year-end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These statutory constraints shape budgetary resource planning and limit free use of fund balances; OBRA surcharge funds remain restricted until appropriated by Congress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deferred revenue recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Revenue is deferred from fees received for services requested but not fully provided and earned (e.g., undeposited checks and fees for applications progressing through examination stages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deferred revenue composition and changes (filing vs. issue fees, undeposited checks) are monitored; process improvements (pre-examination changes) can materially reduce undeposited check liability and shorten deposit lag (e.g., from ~15 days to ~2 days).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund Balance composition and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification of Fund Balance with Treasury into unobligated, restricted, reserved for rescission, obligated funds, etc., and recognition that portions (e.g., OBRA surcharge) are restricted and not available for spending.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial statements may appear to show full cash availability; agencies must disclose reserved and restricted amounts to indicate true available balances for program needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of activity-based costing (ABC) and activity-based management (ABM)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement enterprise-wide ABC to collect and analyze costs associated with processes and services; leverage ABC to provide ABM for better management/control of costs against revenue and enable more effective decision-making and accountability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Next step is linking ABC/ABM data to the budget process to create performance-based budgets and strategic plans; PTO rolled out ABC incrementally and used it to improve cost/resource management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and Executive Information System (EIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDW delivers integrated information from multiple systems grouped by business unit and enforces security rules; EIS will present high-level aggregated data with drill-down and daily updates accessible via web browser.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EDW/EIS intended as decision-support tools to assist executives in strategic and tactical decision-making without additional software; planned enhancements include HR, planning, trademarks, and dissemination data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core accounting system modernization (POD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Move core accounting to client-server using Program Office Desktop (POD) to relate financial accounting functions, monitor budgets/plans, common postings, funds control, and workflow, integrated with standard office software and document imaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider enhancements like Budget Formulation and Fixed Asset modules to support robust planning, budget execution, inventory management, and asset tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet Purchasing Application (IPA) procurement standard
rubrics_metrics.description: Use IPA to accomplish simplified purchasing online with pre-qualified vendors: post RFQs on Internet page, notify vendors by email, accept online quotes that populate procurement systems and interface with POD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPA expedites simplified acquisition, supports DOC acquisition streamlining and socio-economic goals (small business awards), increases competition to lower prices, and posts award notifications publicly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic customer services (TEAS, OEMS) and fee collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide secure online application submission (TEAS) with credit card payment and online order entry/processing (OEMS) for PTO documents, including secure payment validation and order/status checking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronic services improve funds availability, reduce processing time, enhance cash forecasting, lower fraud risk, and increase customer convenience (e.g., TEAS generated >20,000 online trademark filings in FY1999).

rubrics_metrics.name: Automation of administrative programs (Travel Manager, PTS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Automate travel processes for electronic storage and improved processing; automate Public Transportation Subsidy (PTS) program to manage increased participation and accept intranet recertifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automations aim to increase efficiency, accountability, data integrity, and reduce manual mailing/processing burdens as participation scales up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property and equipment investment policy and strategic IT planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustained investment in automation technology prioritized via a five-year Strategic Information Technology Plan updated annually; automation implemented pragmatically, not for its own sake.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: P&E investments intended to modernize operations, reduce cycle times, eliminate paper-based processing, improve data capture/search/retrieval, and support transition to electronic commerce/workplace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deferred revenue and liability monitoring (workload vs. cycle time)
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor deferred revenue trends (filing vs. issue fees) as impacted by changes in workload and cycle times; plateauing deferred revenue can reflect fee changes offset by increased cycle time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analyze workflow patterns (e.g., initial data capture before fee receipt) and their effect on deferred revenue; reductions in undeposited checks indicate process improvements in fee processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net position composition and reporting (CRO and revenue withheld)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report net position split into cumulative results of operations (CRO) and revenue withheld (restricted funds such as OBRA surcharge); disclose effects of revenue withheld on CRO and budget authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CRO should theoretically increase by annual surplus; in practice CRO growth may be limited by diversion to revenue withheld, which reduces agency spending authority despite customer-funded model.
